en: Promise The GM You'll Stop Telling Him About Your Character (GUAL)
name: Обещай мастеру больше не рассказывать о своём персонаже
alt: Разговорчивый игрок запечатал рот и протягивает мастеру цветок примирения.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, clear at 384x384. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm mottled parchment, saturated colors, chunky forms, strong silhouette. Centered subject with comfortable margins, minimal scenery, one visual joke. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, frame or panels. Original composition, not copied card art. Clear plausible anatomy, no unintended extra limbs. Subject: One adult fantasy bard in a flamboyant purple hat sits at a gaming table with a ridiculously long rolled blank character parchment beside him. His mouth is covered by a neat little strip of cream tape, and he offers one daisy with one hand; other hand raised in a solemn promise. Exactly two arms, simple full upper body. Behind a plain game-master screen, only one relieved face with glasses visible, no extra hands, no text.
